Generate memorable, strong passphrases from real words — choose word count, separator and capitalization, with entropy shown.

Store passphrases in a password manager — never reuse one across sites.

📖 How to use

  1. Choose how many words (3–8).
  2. Pick a separator and capitalization style.
  3. Click Generate.
  4. Copy the passphrase and store it in a password manager.

❓ Frequently asked questions

How many words should I use?

Four or more random words give 50+ bits of entropy — strong and memorable. Six words is excellent.

Does it show password strength?

Yes — the estimated entropy in bits is shown for every passphrase.

Which word list is used?

A built-in list of 120 common English words — no repeats within a passphrase.

Can I copy the passphrase?

One tap copies the passphrase to your clipboard.
